descriptor: Indian arm of the French multinational Saint-Gobain, comprising building-materials businesses (e.g., Grindwell Norton Limited) and the International IT Delivery Centre (INDEC) in Mumbai, serving the group's global operations.

classification.pain_point: Large captive IT delivery center (INDEC, 1,900+ staff) managing global SAP/ServiceNow/D365 rollouts across 70 countries; key pains are speed of multi-country deployments, regression testing across complex landscapes, and manual configuration effort during template-driven global implementations.
classification.decision_maker_title: Head of INDEC / VP IT Delivery India / Global SAP Program Director
classification.recent_signal: INDEC headcount grew 7% YoY to 1,932 employees (March 2026) and Microsoft Dynamics 365 was newly detected in the global tech stack (Sept 2026), signaling expanding implementation capacity and new platform adoption.

email: INDEC's 1,932-person team managing SAP and ServiceNow rollouts across 70 countries faces a familiar bottleneck: regression testing every template change before each country go-live. Lab0's AI agents handle configuration, testing, and change requests across SAP, ServiceNow, and Dynamics 365 — cutting implementation cycles from months to days. The September Dynamics 365 addition to your stack suggests another wave of multi-country deployments; would Thursday work for a 15-minute look at the regression-testing step?

quality.suggested_improvement: Add a one-sentence proof point (e.g., "We helped a 50-country SAP rollout cut regression cycles 80%") to make the value claim concrete.
